# DeepSeek Status Lamp for DeepSeek Harness

A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle that puts a **glowing live status lamp in the left sidebar
footer**

and reveals the full DeepSeek platform status when you hover it. Data comes from the
public status
page at <https://status.deepseek.com/>.

- **Capability**: UI / experience — an ambient monitoring decoration, no agent tools added.
- **One

line**: install it and the Harness sidebar grows a live DeepSeek service-status lamp
you can read at
a glance and inspect by hovering.
## Screenshots

> These images are **renders produced from the plugin's own stylesheet**, filled with a real
> statu

s snapshot taken on 2026-11-03 17:17 (UTC+8) during a degraded incident — the sidebar
> around the l

amp is an abstract sketch, the card is the component's real markup. They are not
> window captures o
f a running Harness, which this environment could not produce.
## Install
### From GitHub (source install)
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Replace `web` with whichever profile you run (`desktop`, `web`, or your own). The command is
`pnpm a

dd` underneath, so `github:<owner>/<repo>` installs the checked-out package directly.
Reload the Har
ness Web page once afterwards; the client bundle is served per page load.
### From a local checkout
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then install the directory with the Harness `plugin_manager` (`install_bundle`, absolute
package dir
ectory as `target`).

> **Not on npm yet**, so it does not show up in the in-app 插件中心 (which lists only one-click
> npm pl
ugins). The community marketplace still lists it with the source-install command above.
## What you get

- A **light-tube style lamp** in the sidebar footer: a glass bezel holding ten lit segments,
with a

soft coloured bloom and a faint spill of light below it — about 34px long in the
wide sidebar and 25

px in the collapsed 56px rail, seated at the left edge of the footer row.
- **Colour = state**: gree

n operational · blue maintenance · amber degraded · orange-red
partial outage · red full outage · gr

ey status unavailable. Amber breathes slowly, red
pulses faster, and `prefers-reduced-motion` stops

both.
- **Hover (or keyboard-focus) the lamp** for a card with the overall state, every service
comp

onent grouped by section with its own state, each active incident or maintenance window
with its lat

est update, affected components and update time, plus the upstream source name.
- Text is localized

(English and Chinese) through the host locale service, and every colour is
a host theme token, so it
follows the app's light/dark theme.
## How it gets the data

`status.deepseek.com` is a Next.js app-router page: live data arrives inside the served HTML as
a Re

act flight payload, and the origin sends no CORS headers, so a browser cannot read it
directly. The
bundle therefore has two halves:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- **Host half** (`index.js`) fetches the page every 90s, decodes the `initialData` prop
(component c

atalog + active changes, whose `affected_components[].status` carries each
component's current state

) and normalizes it. If the payload cannot be parsed it falls back
to the `history.rss` incident fee

d. It serves the result as same-origin JSON on an exact
route, so it cannot shadow other routes or t

he SPA fallback.
- **Client half** (`client.js`) registers into the `sidebar.footer.action` slot, po

lls the Host
route every 60s (and when the tab becomes visible again), and draws the lamp plus the h

st
route every 60s (and when the tab becomes visible again), and draws the lamp plus the hover
card.
The browser never calls the status site directly.

`npm run test:live` against the live status page:

A screenshot of the lamp in the sidebar is still to be added — the lamp renders in the
Harness Web U

## Compatibility and requirements
| Item | Value |
| DeepSeek Harness | developed and verified on Desktop runtime `0.2.1-rc.5`; the bundle uses only st

able extension points (`webServer.register`, `sidebar.footer.action`, `locale`) |
| Platform | macOS

verified; Windows / Linux expected to work (plain JS, no native code) but not verified |
| Runtime
| no dependencies, no build step; Host half needs a Node with global `fetch` and `AbortSignal.timeou

t` (Node 18+, DSH ships newer) |
| Permissions | no agent tools, no credentials, no filesystem acces

s; one outbound HTTPS GET to the public status page every 90s |
| External services | `status.deepse
ek.com` (status page and its `history.rss` fallback); everything else stays local |
## 收录信息（中文）

- **分类**：界面与体验
- **一句话价值**：装好后左侧栏底部多一根发光灯管，随时反映 status.deepseek.com 上的服务状态，悬停即可看到全部组件、进行中事件与更新时间。
-

**安装命令**：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:gmchocolate/dsh-deepseek-status`
- **兼容**：DeepSeek Har

ness Desktop `0.2.1-rc.5` 实测通过；macOS 已验证，Windows/Linux 未验证；无第三方依赖、无构建步骤。
- **许可证**：MIT
- **权限与外部服务**
：不注册任何 Agent 工具、不读取凭据与文件；仅每 90 秒对公开状态页发起一次 HTTPS 请求（失败时退回其 RSS 事件流），数据经本机同源路由 `/plugins/deepseek-sta

tus.json` 提供给前端。
- **已知限制**：上游页面结构变化时会先退回 RSS 兜底、再显示灰色「状态不可用」；悬浮卡片用 `position: fixed` 定位，若宿主给侧栏祖先加了
- **已知限制**：上游页面结构变化时会先退回 RSS 兜底、再显示灰色「状态不可用」；悬浮卡片用 `position: fixed` 定位，若宿主给侧栏祖先加了 `transform` 会有偏移。
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

There are no dependencies and no build step: the Host half is a plain Cordis plugin and the
Client h

alf is a plain lazy module (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`). The tests use only Node
built-ins and a
tiny React stand-in, so they run offline.
